meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 会在 agent 容器里安装 mnemon,并注册 Claude Code 钩子:回话前自动调取相关记忆,每轮结束后写入新见解。记忆写入每个 agent group 的 .claude/ 挂载,容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当 agent group 使用默认 Claude provider(container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude)时适用;若设成其他 provider,mnemon 钩子不会被调用。

say.text: 把 mnemon 装到容器镜像里
确认容器里的 mnemon 钩子已经注册
开个新会话,引用我们刚才聊过的内容
say.note: 用来测试能否自动调取之前的上下文

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container image and registers Claude Code hooks that surface relevant memory before each response and store new insights after each turn. Memory persists in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount.
howto.when_en: Applies to agent groups using the default Claude provider (container.json provider absent or claude). Hooks only fire under --target claude-code; a different provider never invokes the claude CLI.

say_en.text: Install mnemon into the container image.
say_en.note: Edits the Dockerfile and runs mnemon setup at each start.

say_en.text: Check that the mnemon hooks are registered in the container.
Start a new session and reference what we discussed earlier.
